name: Unidentified Ore
summary: At Windshear Crag, Unidentified Ore draws the Venture Company's attention. Piznik recovered a sample and passed it to Ziz Fizziks for study in Undermine.

sections.title: A Curious Strike in Windshear
sections.body: The Venture Company's clear-cutting and strip mining at Windshear Crag exposed unusual mineral strata in the Stonetalon Mountains. The site's new boss, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, ordered large amounts of strange gold-green ore mined. Demoted goblin worker Piznik remained loyal to his fired former boss, Ziz Fizziks, and secured a sample while plotting his exit from the outfit. He handed it to a traveler bound for the crag's western ridge. Ziz planned to send most of the ore to Undermine for study and keep a small cut for personal profit.

faq.answer: The Unidentified Ore is a mineral sample dug up during Venture Company operations at Windshear Crag. Its composition draws the interest of Ziz Fizziks and mining engineers in Undermine.

Piznik, a Venture Company goblin stationed at Windshear Crag, salvaged the sample. After recent mishaps, he feared retribution from company supervisors and saw a chance to flee and secure new employment.

faq.q: Who is trying to study this sample?
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks, a goblin camped along the western edge of Windshear Crag, received the mineral. He plans to send most of it to engineers in Undermine and keep a small portion for himself.

faq.q: Why does Undermine care about this stone?
faq.answer: Goblins scout for new explosive, metallurgical, or combustible materials. A strange mineral from Kalimdor's ancient mountains could hold industrial and commercial potential for the trade cartels.

angles.text: Miners find ordinary veins throughout Windshear Crag, but this sample defies common trade knowledge and intrigues even Undermine's best appraisers.
Goblincraft seeks raw compounds with unique reactive properties, so unclassified ores from untamed crags give innovative tinkers material to study.
